name: Due Date 1
definition: Specifies the date by when the financial institutiion needs to provide a response.

DueDate.name: Due Date
DueDate.definition: Specifies the date when the authority needs the response in situations where the response or part of it will not be given electronically but on paper in manual process.

AdditionalInformation.name: Additional Information
AdditionalInformation.definition: Specifies the reason why the authority needs the information on due date.
